meta.title: Fix: Resolve browser multiplication issue in Puppeteer MCP server
meta.body_summary: Fix Puppeteer MCP server browser multiplication issue where multiple Chrome instances were created per tool call, leading to resource exhaustion; implements browser health checks, launch concurrency protection, graceful cleanup, and signal handlers.

perf_labels.notes: Claude_Code fix for Puppeteer browser multiplication characterized by resource leak; PR closed because repository is archived.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 170 changed lines in a single file, this is a small edit by absolute volume. It fits a focused bug-fix performance PR. However, it was closed rather than merged because the repository is archived and unmaintained, which is inconsistent with the fix's size and potential value.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer olaservo noted that the Puppeteer reference server has been archived and is no longer maintained, advising to maintain own fork.
review_details.performance_claim: Fix browser multiplication: stable Chrome process count (15) regardless of tool calls, versus previous continuous growth from 6 to 15+ processes.
review_details.rejection_signals: Project archived; maintainer closed without reviewing fix.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Although the fix is technically sound, the agent did not identify that the target repository was archived, leading to an automatic rejection regardless of code quality.

detection_detail.code_reading: No code review performed; maintainer only commented on repository status.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body provides symptom counts and a before/after fix claim, but no reproduction script, benchmark, or profiler evidence.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merging due to repository archive status; no code review or performance validation occurred.

core_change_summary.description: Modified src/puppeteer/index.ts to add isBrowserHealthy(), browserLaunching flag, graceful close with timeout, process signal handlers, and platform-specific Chrome process cleanup.
change_trajectory: Single commit implementing health checks, launch concurrency, cleanup, and signal handlers.

review_signals.summary: Maintainer said the server is archived and no longer maintained; recommended forking.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with full fix in one commit.
After ~3 days, maintainer commented about archive and closed the PR; no human code review occurred.
